title: Implement flat-file handoff write and read operations
description: Build on the handoff contract to extend provider.Provider and the flat-file provider with create/list behavior. Writes must resolve --task-style UUID or short IDs to a canonical UUID, append by default, and atomically replace only the selected global or task scope when requested. Reads must support global-only default scope, one task, or all scopes; return newest-first with ID tie-breaking; apply a positive limit or no limit; and report totalMatching, hasMore, and otherScopesAvailable. Return a write receipt containing the new handoff and retained count. Validate before mutation and preserve missing-file compatibility. No CLI parsing in this task.
